m.heard: She'd never even kept a borrowed paper clip. Then she read one sign and wanted to steal. She leaned over to her fiance and whispered, We'd better get ours now. But why would a warning make an honest person want to steal? With many past visitors, almost 8%, the sign didn't stop thieves, it gave them permission.
